info.title: AttendanceWeb API
info.description: Endpoints: accounts, classrooms, enrollment, calendar/weekly series, QR attendance, corrections/audit, assignments/private uploads/submissions/published grades and inbox. Local validation evidence and limits: docs/ASSIGNMENTS-GRADES.md and docs/evidence/learning-validation.md. Cookie session + CSRF: GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie then send X-XSRF-TOKEN and credentials. React frontend is implemented in atd_react; quizzes and chat are not implemented.
